about.title: About BuildRight
about.intro: Practical guides to construction: planning and design, foundations and structure, materials, site safety and finishing. General information for homeowners and builders.

sections.heading: Why we exist
sections.body: Good construction starts with good information. BuildRight explains how buildings are planned, built and maintained in plain language, so owners and builders can make better decisions.

sections.heading: What we cover
sections.body:
- **Planning & Design** — budgets, permits and plans.
- **Foundations & Structure** — site preparation, concrete and walls.
- **Materials & Methods** — bricks, blocks, steel and timber.
- **Safety & Site Management** — protective gear and running a site.
- **Finishing & Maintenance** — waterproofing, plaster, paint and upkeep.

sections.heading: Important
sections.body: Everything here is general information. Building rules, permits and safety requirements differ by location. Always follow your local codes and consult a qualified engineer, architect or licensed contractor.
